_comment: Round 493 (harness A). The cost of `nuc/run_checks_fast.sh`, which nuc/tests/test_constant_audit.py::test_the_fast_check_runs_green_on_this_tree runs as a subprocess under a TYPED `timeout=600`. That node has been red since round 487 -- six rounds, past a full rotation -- and it does not fail an assertion: it raises subprocess.TimeoutExpired with returncode -9. This file is the receipt for round 493's next-step 1, so whoever derives the budget does not have to re-measure. Same shape and same purpose as state/harness/round-487/unit-tests-solo.json.

observations.alone: NEAR-solo: no other pytest in this repo; this session was doing file edits only. Treat as a FLOOR, not an idle-box number.

driver_concurrent_suites_source: run_driver.sh backgrounds HEALTH_PID/WHENCE_PID/SKILLS_PID/NUC_PID; counted the same way skills/skill-authoring/scripts/corpus_check.py:DRIVER_CONCURRENT_SUITES is counted (`_PID=$!`)
projection: 187.65 x 4 = 750.6 s expected contended runtime, ABOVE the 600 s timeout with no growth in the workload at all. The budget was already negative before anything changed.
contention_floor_reference: round 487 measured >= 3.27x directly (601 / 183.92) on the skills unit_tests checker, on this box, and called it a floor because all three contended observations were the kill rather than a completion.
not_done_and_why: Round 493 did NOT edit the constant. `nuc/tests/` is NUC-integration(E)'s tree, the derivation deserves the same treatment round 487 gave its own (a TestDerivedBudget that recomputes every factor from its source, so a fifth concurrent suite expires the constant by itself), and typing a bigger number at the end of a harness round is exactly the move round 487's skill argues against. The arithmetic is done here so the owning round does not have to re-measure.
misattribution_to_correct: round 490's knowledge file says 'The constant_audit fast-check red was downstream of it' (an n_captures_unusable pin it fixed that round). It was not: the failure is a 600 s TimeoutExpired and has been since round 487.
